data.name: Filberte
data.gender_notes: Filberte is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Philomela, meaning 'friend of Aphrodite' and 'shining one'. In Greek mythology, Philomela was a woman who was transformed into a nightingale and regained her human form through the power of love. The name Filberte carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Filberte usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the transformative power of love and the light that shines within each of us.
data.etymology: Filberte belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filberte total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: פילברטה
in_hebrew.meaning: פילברטה משמעות שם נוצרי חזק ומאמין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פילברטה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בגרמנית ומשמעותו 'חזק במאמינו' או 'מאמין חזק'. השם פילברטה מורכב משני מילים: 'פיל' שמשמעותו 'חזק' ו-'ברטה' שמשמעותו 'זוהר' או 'מאמין'. השם פילברטה היה נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים בימי הביניים וסימל את האמונה והחוזק של הנושא אותו.

in_greek.name: Φιλβέρτη
in_greek.long_meaning: Φιλβέρτη είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ισχυρός στην πίστη' ή 'πιστός ισχυρός'. Το όνομα Φιλβέρτη αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'φιλ' που σημαίνει 'ισχυρός' και 'βέρτη' που σημαίνει 'φως' ή 'πίστη'. Το όνομα Φιλβέρτη ήταν κοινό ανάμεσα στους χριστιανούς κατά τον Μεσαίωνα και συμβόλιζε την πίστη και τη δύναμη του φορέα του.

in_latin.name: Filberte
in_latin.meaning: Filberte significat nomen christianum forte et fidelem
in_latin.long_meaning: Filberte est nomen christianum quod originem habet in lingua germanica et significat 'fortis in fide' vel 'fidelis fortis'. Nomen Filberte constat ex duabus vocibus: 'fil' quod significat 'fortis' et 'berte' quod significat 'lumen' vel 'fides'. Nomen Filberte fuit commune inter christianos in medio aevo et significabat fidem et fortitudinem eius qui hoc nomen gerebat.

in_english.name: Filberte

in_english.long_meaning: Filberte is a Christian name derived from Germanic roots, meaning 'strong in faith' or 'faithful and strong'. The name Filberte is composed of two elements: 'fil' meaning 'strong' and 'berte' meaning 'bright' or 'faith'. Historically, the name Filberte was popular among Christians during the Middle Ages, symbolizing the faith and strength of its bearer. The name reflects a deep spiritual significance, embodying the virtues of resilience and devotion. In modern Christian cultures, Filberte remains a meaningful choice for parents seeking a name that conveys spiritual fortitude and commitment.
